subject: Hosted API demo request — compact evaluation for Cartlify
messages:
From: Alex Russo <alex.russo@cartlify.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-14T16:12:00Z
Subject: Interested in a short hosted API demo

Hi Jordan,

I signed up for the hosted API sandbox this morning and dug in a bit — looks promising. We're evaluating options to replace a third-party summarization service in our support product and want to validate latency/quality on a small sample.

Would you have 30 minutes available for a compact demo and a quick look at the sandbox? Preferably PST afternoon next week, but we can be flexible. I can loop in our product lead, Samantha.

Attached a one-page note on our use case.

Thanks,
Alex Russo
Director of ML, Cartlify
alex.russo@cartlify.ai

Attachment: cartlify-selfserve-brief.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Russo <alex.russo@cartlify.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-14T16:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Interested in a short hosted API demo

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up.

We can absolutely do a 30-minute compact evaluation focused on latency, throughput, and a guided run through your sample prompts. Two quick options that work on our side:
- Tue 2028-07-18 14:00–14:30 PDT
- Wed 2028-07-19 11:00–11:30 PDT

If neither fits, reply with 2–3 windows that work and we’ll pick one. I also included Diego from SDR for calendar handling and Soojin (PLG) who can jump in with a short technical preflight if you’d like a deeper look under the hood.

Quick pre-demo checklist (also attached): a short sample of prompts, an example payload size, and which metrics matter most (p95 latency, token cost, quality threshold). If you can drop that into the thread we’ll tailor the demo.

Calendly (optional): https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-compact-demo-30

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
SDR, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.md (text)
From: Alex Russo <alex.russo@cartlify.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@cartlify.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short hosted API demo

Thanks Jordan — both of those slots are close, but we have an all-hands on Tue afternoon. Can we move to Wed 2028-07-19 11:00 PST (your second option) — that should work for Samantha and me.

Also two small asks before the demo:
1) Can Soojin share a 10–15 minute technical preflight to confirm tokenization/latency expectations?
2) Can you provision a sandbox token that includes ~10k tokens for us to run 1–2 realistic batches prior to the session? That will let us exercise the exact prompt shapes we plan to demo.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the walkthrough.

— Alex

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Russo <alex.russo@cartlify.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short hosted API demo

Hi Alex + Samantha — happy to run the technical preflight. I can do a 15-minute slot the same day immediately before the demo to keep things tight: Wed 2028-07-19 10:30–10:45 PDT (15min). During that sync I’ll confirm:
- tokenization behavior for multi-turn prompts
- expected p95 latency for the sample lengths you sent
- sandbox token and how to run small batched requests

Sandbox invite: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/invite/Cartlify-4G2Q (token will be active for 72 hours prior to the scheduled demo).

If that preflight works I’ll provision 10k test tokens and drop a short runbook in the sandbox workspace. If you prefer a different preflight time, send two alternatives.

— Soojin
PLG Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Russo <alex.russo@cartlify.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-17T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 2028-07-19 — preflight + compact demo (Cartlify)

Perfect — Wed 2028-07-19 is booked on our side. Final schedule below:
- 10:30–10:45 PDT: Technical preflight with Soojin (15m)
- 11:00–11:30 PDT: Compact hosted API demo with Jordan + PLG (30m)

I’ve added both events to your calendar via the Calendly link and shared the sandbox invite Soojin posted. Diego — any calendar notes or room links you want to add on Redwood's side?

Look forward to it. If you want to attach any additional sample prompts before Tuesday EOD we’ll run them in the sandbox and have results ready to show.

Best,
Jordan
SDR, Redwood Inference
Quoted (from earlier): On 2028-07-15 Soojin Lee wrote: > I can do a 15-minute slot the same day immediately before the demo to keep things tight: Wed 2028-07-19 10:30–10:45 PDT (15min).
